question: What kinds of devotion must be absent in a person deemed unfit to receive the teaching?
premises: Devotion to the kula may be absent
Devotion to the guru may be absent
Such absence defines an unfit recipient
inference: One devoid of devotion to both kula and guru is unfit.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues in the following verses.
plain_english: Indeed, in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
